title: Start (POST), answer (PUT) or cancel (DELETE) a relayed integration login

address.description: Present to sign an existing account in again.

level.description: The account level to sign in at, one the provider lists as available; anything else is refused with 409 level_unavailable. Absent: a renewal keeps the account's own level, a new account gets the broadest available. Signing an existing account in at another level changes its level: files that stop syncing both ways are synced both ways once more first; Dropbox revokes the replaced login after the new sign-in, and Google, whose revocation ends every token of the application, revokes the old grant before the sign-in starts (an abandoned sign-in then leaves the account signed out).

oneOf.description: At the folder choice of a provider whose login also serves other services than files: complete the sign-in without syncing files. Nothing is copied; the files service then reports not_chosen, and signing in again offers the choice. A provider whose only service is files, or an account whose files already sync (a renewal), refuses it (400).
